scientific_integrity: A symbolic all-integer proof reduces confidence membership to strict even/odd inequalities and affine contraction. An exact rational checker samples \(2\le p\le200\); finite checks do not constitute the infinite proof. Publication-priority uncertainty remains. No independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: For each prescribed integer period the confidence set is tailored to that period; local attraction is only in the ordinary opinion with stubborn opinions fixed; no global basin or period classification for a fixed confidence set is claimed. The confidence sets are nonconvex and disconnected.
title: Arbitrarily long attracting opinion cycles with three agents and seven confidence intervals
